## Objective

Set up Neon PostgreSQL database and configure Prisma schema for the Marketing OS.

## Unified Context

The Marketing Operating System needs a cloud database for the webapp and a local database for Paperclip agents. Neon provides serverless PostgreSQL that syncs with local Turso DB.

Current gap: No database is configured, cannot proceed with CMS UI or agent system.

## Problem

Without a cloud database:
- Webapp cannot persist user data
- Cannot sync with local DB for Paperclip agents
- NBA items cannot be stored or tracked

## Goal

Configure Neon + Prisma as the primary data layer.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Create Neon project
- Configure Prisma with Neon provider
- Define all data models (User, Company, Product, Customer, Competitor, NBAItem, Feedback)
- Environment configuration for local and cloud

### Out of Scope
- Local sync layer (Phase 6)
- Paperclip agent setup (Phase 5)

## Constraints
- Must use Neon PostgreSQL
- Must be compatible with Turso for local sync later

## Acceptance Checks
- [ ] Neon project created with connection string
- [ ] Prisma schema defines all models
- [ ] DATABASE_URL configured in .env
- [ ] Schema pushes successfully to Neon

## Dependencies
- Blocking: SPEC.md approval

## Risks
- Neon free tier limits may restrict usage
- Connection string format changes frequently
content.title: Phase 1: Set up Neon DB and Prisma Schema

## Objective

Implement the NBA (Next Best Action) generation engine that recommends 3 actions to users.

## Unified Context

The marketing OS needs to analyze user data and recommend the highest-value actions. The NBA engine uses ICE scoring to prioritize.

Current gap: No logic to generate recommendations.

## Problem

Without NBA engine:
- Users have no actionable guidance
- Cannot prioritize marketing tasks
- No way to measure importance of actions

## Goal

Build NBA engine that:
- Generates exactly 3 NBA items
- Uses ICE scoring (Impact x Confidence x Ease)
- Handles rotten period (7 days)
- Integrates with Paperclip agents

## Scope

### In Scope
- ICE scoring formula
- NBA generation (always 3 items)
- Rotten period handling (score decay)
- Priority queue

### Out of Scope
- Paperclip agents (Phase 5)
- Feedback learning (Phase 4)

## Acceptance Checks
- [ ] ICE formula implemented
- [ ] Always returns exactly 3 items
- [ ] Rotten period decays score by 5/day
- [ ] Items sorted by priority

## Dependencies
- Phase 2: CMS Webapp
content.title: Phase 3: NBA Engine

content.body:
## Objective

Implement user feedback loop on NBA items - accept with optional note, decline with mandatory annotation.

## Unified Context

The system learns from user feedback to improve NBA recommendations. Accept boosts similar future items, decline with mandatory annotation heavily penalizes.

Current gap: User cannot provide feedback on recommendations.

## Problem

Without feedback:
- System cannot learn user preferences
- Recommendations don't improve
- No way to filter bad suggestions

## Goal

Build feedback system:
- Accept action (optional annotation)
- Decline action (mandatory annotation)
- ICE score adjustment
- Learning algorithm

## Scope

### In Scope
- Accept button (optional note)
- Decline button (mandatory note)
- Score adjustment: accept +10%, decline -50%
- Feedback logging

### Out of Scope
- Paperclip agents (Phase 5)
- Sync layer (Phase 6)

## Acceptance Checks
- [ ] User can accept NBA item
- [ ] User can decline with required note
- [ ] Score adjusts correctly
- [ ] Feedback logged to DB

## Dependencies
- Phase 3: NBA Engine

## Objective

Implement daily sync between local DB (Turso) and cloud DB (Neon).

## Unified Context

The marketing OS is local-first. Cloud is only a sync target. Local DB runs 24/7 with Paperclip agents, cloud DB serves the webapp.

Current gap: No sync mechanism.

## Problem

Without sync:
- Webapp cannot see local data
- Local changes never reach cloud
- No daily operation

## Goal

Build sync layer:
- Local → Cloud push (daily at 03:00)
- Cloud → Local pull (daily)
- Cron job for sync
- Conflict resolution (local wins)

## Scope

### In Scope
- Turso local DB setup
- Push to Neon (local → cloud)
- Pull from Neon (cloud → local)
- Cron job for daily sync

### Out of Scope
- Real-time sync (not needed)

## Acceptance Checks
- [ ] Turso local DB configured
- [ ] Push to Neon works
- [ ] Pull from Neon works
- [ ] Cron runs daily

## Dependencies
- Phase 5: Paperclip Agents

# IDEABANK: Marketing Skills Integration

## Objective

Build a comprehensive marketing skill library that transforms into NBA (Next Best Action) recommendations for users. Integrate marketingskills from coreyhaines31/marketingskills (30+ skills) and other sources into our Checklist Marketing OS.

## Unified Context

Our Marketing OS currently generates NBA items from user-uploaded data (products, customers, competitors) via Paperclip agents. Adding a skill library will enable:

1. **Skill-triggered NBAs**: When user uploads data, system matches relevant skills to generate actions
2. **Guided Workflows**: Users can invoke skills directly to get step-by-step marketing guidance
3. **Quality Templates**: Every marketing task uses best-practice frameworks from proven skills

## Based On

- Source: coreyhaines31/marketingskills (MIT license)
- Quality standard: https://github.com/moldovancsaba/agent.meimei/issues/49

## Problem

Current gaps in our system:
- No marketing expertise beyond generic AI
- Users get generic advice, not specialized frameworks
- Skills are not connected to user data/context

## Goal

Build Marketing Skill IDEABANK that:
- Adds 30+ core skills to our system (SEO, CRO, Copywriting, Email, etc.)
- Creates skill-to-NBA mapping
- Enables user-triggered skill workflows

## Scope

### In Scope
- Integration with coreyhaines31/marketingskills (30+ skills)
- Skill-to-NBA conversion rules
- User-invokable skill commands
- Skill context injection

### Out of Scope
- Paperclip agent setup (Phase 5)
- Local sync (Phase 6)

## Skills Categories

### Conversion Optimization (6 skills)
- page-cro, signup-flow-cro, onboarding-cro, form-cro, popup-cro, paywall-upgrade-cro

### Content & Copy (5 skills)
- copywriting, copy-editing, cold-email, email-sequence, social-content

### SEO & Discovery (6 skills)
- seo-audit, ai-seo, programmatic-seo, site-architecture, competitor-alternatives, schema-markup

### Paid & Distribution (2 skills)
- paid-ads, ad-creative

### Measurement (2 skills)
- analytics-tracking, ab-test-setup

### Retention (1 skill)
- churn-prevention

### Growth (2 skills)
- free-tool-strategy, referral-program

### Strategy (4 skills)
- marketing-ideas, marketing-psychology, launch-strategy, pricing-strategy

### Sales (2 skills)
- revops, sales-enablement

### Research (2 skills)
- customer-research, product-marketing-context

## Execution

Build skill templates that include:
- When to use the skill (trigger conditions)
- Framework steps
- Expected outputs
- ICE scoring for generated NBAs
- Related skills mapping

## Constraints

- Must integrate with existing NBA engine (Phase 3)
- Skills should use product-marketing-context
- NBA items must have ICE scores

## Acceptance Checks
- [ ] Skills available in IDEABANK
- [ ] Skill can be triggered by user command
- [ ] Skill generates relevant NBA with ICE score
- [ ] Skill uses proper context

## Delivery Artifact

Complete skill library in IDEABANK/skills/ with:
- 30+ skill markdown files
- Skill-to-NBA conversion code
- User command integration

## Dependencies

- Phase 5: Paperclip Agents (skills need agents to execute)
- Phase 3: NBA Engine (skills generate NBA items)

## Risks

- Too many skills = paralysis by analysis
- Need prioritization (high-impact skills first)
- Skill quality varies by source
content.title: IDEABANK: Marketing Skills Integration
